content_html:
Agreed, it’s a great little utility.

You might also be interested in Window Clippings:

http://weblogs.asp.net/kennykerr/archive/2007/01/28/window-clippings-1-5.aspx

which makes taking Vista screenshots easier, and also Paint.NET which I find is invaluable for editing screenshots for publication – my take on it:

http://www.feedghost.com/Blogs/BlogEntry.aspx?EntryId=60

Sometimes I just print-screen and use Paint.NET to trim down, it’s that easy.
